propositions.canonicalProposition: The card-fraud model documented by the candidate passed independent validation in June 2024 under record MRV-2024-031 with no high-severity findings, as the head of model risk management confirmed in writing.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the written confirmation and the validation record; the resume describes the documentation the candidate prepared.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built an XGBoost card-fraud model on 18 months of labelled transactions.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the method, the data period and the features.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reported monthly alert precision and fraud value detected by rule and score band to the head of fraud operations.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the report and the work sample is one month's anonymised report.

expectedGap: The candidate explored device-fingerprint data with data engineering; device or behavioural features built into a model are not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the validation outcome with its record, the model build and the alert-quality reporting as documented; the packet lists evidence and gaps only.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which device or behavioural features the candidate designed and whether any went into a validated model.
